key_insight: CRC-HGD is a labeled histopathology dataset that supports automated grading of colorectal adenocarcinoma across three WHO differentiation grades and four magnification levels.
clinical_relevance: A standardized image dataset like CRC-HGD can help accelerate AI tools for colorectal cancer grading, which may support pathology workflow and prognosis assessment.
method: 1,914 H&E microscopy images from 214 colorectal adenocarcinoma patients
Three grades: Grade I (106), Grade II (75), Grade III (33)
evidence_signal: The dataset contains 1,914 images from 214 patients collected between 2014 and 2019 and labeled by WHO criteria for three differentiation grades.
watch_item: The class distribution is imbalanced, especially for Grade III, so model performance may be biased if this is not handled carefully.
paper_title: CRC-HGD: A Histopathological Image Dataset for Grading Colorectal Cancer
